# Membrane API
> Membrane is an API routing layer for agentic swarms that provides L2 Semantic Caching and Zero-Shot Isolation to reduce token bloat, cut costs by 50%+, and drop latency to 150ms.

## Integration
Membrane is a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI API.

- Base URL: `https://membrane-wh1g.onrender.com/v1`
- Auth Header: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`
- Primary Endpoint: `/chat/completions`
- Models Endpoint: `GET /v1/models` (Supported natively for client SDK validation checks)

## Example (Python)
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://membrane-wh1g.onrender.com/v1",
    api_key="sk_live_..."
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="membrane",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of Washington?"}
    ]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Zero-Shot Isolation Rules
Membrane strips conversational bloat to prevent context hallucination. 
- Put ALL persistent agent logic/rules in the `system` message.
- Put the immediate task in the *last* `user` message. 
- Membrane will ignore intermediate `assistant` messages to prevent context degradation.
